items.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999
items.q: I’m into this Chet Baker project and I’m trying to gather some investors to help me come up with 27 thousand bucks so that I can go in there and do this tribute to Chet Baker where I will sing all of his tunes.

ctx.x: So sometimes the producers and so forth know what they’re talking about.

Sometimes they know what they’re talking about. I must say that it took me years to learn that lesson and I’ve finally gotten over that hump. I now know what the people really want to hear. That’s why I’m singing now. I’m into this Chet Baker project and I’m trying to gather some investors to help me come up with 27 thousand bucks so that I can go in there and do this tribute to Chet Baker where I will sing all of his tunes. Jerome was kidding me about it the other day but I’m dead serious about it. I could do…
